question: Where is the nearest gallery you’d find going toward Senior Helpers, Largo, FL starting at Sarasota Art Museum, Sarasota, FL?
sql: WITH start_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sarasota Art Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), end_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Senior Helpers%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Largo%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1 ), target_info AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography)) AS target_azimuth, s.geometry AS start_geom, e.geometry AS end_geom, ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) AS total_distance_start_to_end FROM start_poi s, end_poi e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, target_info ti WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' -- Ensure the gallery is not further from the start point than the destination itself AND ST_Distance(ti.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) <= ti.total_distance_start_to_end -- Ensure the gallery is within a 45-degree cone towards the destination AND LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ti.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - ti.target_azimuth), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ti.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - ti.target_azimuth) ) < 45 ORDER BY ST_Distance(ti.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
